title: Execution beginning with one gate
statement: Let $\beta$ be a type, let $f$ assign a value in $\beta$ to each gate and current list of values, let $g$ be a gate, let $g_s$ be a list of gates, and let $I$ be an initial list of values. Executing $g::g_s$ from $I$ gives the same list as executing $g_s$ from the list obtained by appending $f(g,I)$ to $I$.
